decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app sits close to the core practice software, was launched as a new product line, and fits the digitalisation trend, so in a growing firm with slack it likely meets aspirations.
The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training resources and strengthens customer ties; it is only moderately at risk because in-person education suffered during the pandemic.
Remote screen-sharing support is a low-cost part of the support infrastructure, and its value increased with remote work, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.

The performance analytics dashboard extends the core software toward data-driven practice management, matching the firm's strategic direction, and the firm's slack lets it be carried while uptake matures.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages the established offer for new and larger practices, so it costs little to maintain and supports sales.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from core competencies and faces strong competition from generalist portals, so it is the most likely to fall short of aspirations, but its low running cost and community value probably keep it alive another year.
